channel.title: Star Catcher: new Claude repos
channel.description: New Claude, Claude Code and MCP repos, found every 6 hours.

item.title: blender-ai-mcp-addon by bookwjitchieni1986 (★1.9k)
item.description: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender: visual chat, scene tools, multi-agent workflows. Works with ChatGPT/GPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, OpenCode. Blender AI addon, copilot for 3D, bpy Python scripting, MCP integration.

item.title: gtavi-claudecode by Bodila51 (★1.0k)
item.description: Claude Code plugin that turns GTA 6 streams into paid vertical clips: live campaigns, trending videos, best moments, 9:16 cuts with hooks, captions and credits.

item.title: nihongo by AnIT012 (★228)
item.description: AIが書く日本語を、人が書く文に近づけるエージェントスキル。Claude、ChatGPT、Claude Code、Codexなどで使えます。

item.title: boring-marketing-skills by boringmarketer (★529)
item.description: 32 free marketing skills for your AI agent: research, positioning, copy, pages, SEO, AI search, ads, email and content, plus a deep local-business pack. MIT.

item.title: motlab by staryone (★269)
item.description: Video as code: canvas scenes rendered with WebCodecs in headless Chrome, a review viewer, and agent skills that build the video from your references.

item.title: rust-anything by erkamyaman (★6.8k)
item.description: Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.

item.title: claude-multi-desktop by jackson-cmd (★231)
item.description: Run multiple Claude Desktop accounts at the same time on Mac: separate sign-ins, custom icons, one shared Claude Code setup, and sessions that message each other across accounts. brew install jackson-cmd/tap/claude-multi-desktop

item.title: craft by diego3g (★321)
item.description: Design skills for AI agents: /craft-setup writes your design brief, /craft designs screens with every state from your design system and reviews them. Works with Paper, pen.dev, Figma or HTML.

item.title: serum-2-desktop by azure-fossil-maker (★210)
item.description: Serum 2 2026 standalone bundle with full plugin suite, multitrack editor, bundled instruments and portable offline mode for Windows 11

item.title: Capri-AI by Outpostkrewhirl86 (★345)
item.description: Capri: a local-first desktop AI agent with a cyberpunk HUD. Your personal Jarvis for Windows. Controls files, apps, terminal and browser, powered by Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or any backend. Inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.
